about: Claude scheduled tasks (tracked in https://github.com/haxtheweb/issues/issues/3262). They run outside GitHub, so this list is kept here; build_quality.py checks each one's output on GitHub to tell whether it is producing anything. Snapshot of the account's scheduled tasks, 2026-11-10.

tasks.name: Nightly translations
tasks.guards: New and changed English strings reach every language, in one rolling PR.

tasks.name: Documentation pass
tasks.guards: Element docs and demos keep up with their properties and HAXSchema; broken links are fixed. Ecosystem web PRs in praw start once the graph data lives there.

tasks.name: What's New candidates
tasks.guards: Merged changes people would notice are drafted as What's New and Tips entries.

tasks.name: Element tours
tasks.guards: Element walkthroughs are redrafted when an element's surface changes; approved ones are listed for review.

tasks.name: Accessibility sweep
tasks.guards: Element demos are checked with axe in light, dark and reduced motion; clear fixes come in one rolling PR.

tasks.name: Weekly sweep
tasks.guards: Stale and duplicate issues, stale PRs and branches, bot job health and agent drift are flagged in one report. Flag only.

tasks.name: Fuzz hunt

output.flag_only: Opens a [fuzz] issue only when a property fails; a quiet night produces nothing.

tasks.guards: Seeded property-based tests look for inputs that break the CLI, haxcms-nodejs and webcomponents (https://github.com/haxtheweb/issues/issues/3272).
